prompts.prompt: Create ONE production game sprite atlas PNG for a classic Rogue graphical map, named ITEMS atlas. Use case: stylized-concept. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells, square overall image, perfectly regular grid. Each sprite centered INSIDE its own cell with generous transparent margins; no lines between cells, no labels, no letters, no captions. READ LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM: 1 gold coin pile; 2 corked round potion bottle filled coral red; 3 rolled parchment scroll tied by a string; 4 simple travel food ration loaf and cheese; 5 steel sword representing weapons; 6 steel cuirass representing armor; 7 golden ring with small green stone; 8 wooden magic staff with a modest blue tip, representing both staff and wand; 9 golden triangular Amulet of Yendor with red stone. All nine are DISTINCT, one icon per cell, none repeated or missing. Style: simple fantasy game illustrations, VERY THICK dark charcoal ink outlines, clean flat fills, only two or three tones per object, clear bold silhouette, readable when reduced to 32 pixels, unified restrained earth/steel/gold palette and light highlights for a dark dungeon. Slight top-down three-quarter game-icon viewpoint. Keep each silhouette completely within the central 70 percent of its cell. Genuinely transparent background with alpha, no checkerboard, no ground plates, no surrounding scene, no shadows outside silhouettes, no tiny ornamental detail, no gradients or blurred glow, no watermark. Not pixel art, not text glyphs. This is one technical sprite-sheet asset.
